# Artisan — AI Sales Employees

Artisan builds AI sales employees ("Artisans") that automate your entire outbound sales process. Our flagship AI BDR, Ava, sources leads, researches prospects, writes personalized emails, and books meetings — all on autopilot.

## Consolidate your outbound stack
Artisan replaces a fragmented stack of prospecting tools with a single AI-first platform: a 300M+ contact B2B database, email warmup and deliverability, automated personalization, and a built-in CRM.

## Built for modern revenue teams
Fast-growing B2B startups and mid-market sales teams use Artisan to scale pipeline without scaling headcount.

## Trusted by high-growth teams
Hundreds of sales teams rely on Artisan to fill their calendars with qualified meetings.

# About Artisan

Artisan is on a mission to automate go-to-market. We believe the future of sales is AI employees that work alongside human reps. Founded in 2023, Artisan is headquartered in San Francisco and backed by leading venture investors.

## Who we serve
Our customers are primarily B2B SaaS and technology companies with sales-led motions, typically from seed stage through mid-market (roughly 10 to 500 employees). Sales leaders — VPs of Sales, Heads of Growth, and founders — adopt Artisan to hit pipeline targets efficiently.

## The problem we solve
Outbound is expensive and slow. Hiring, ramping, and managing BDRs is costly, and most prospecting tools are disconnected. Artisan consolidates the workflow and removes manual busywork.

# Pricing

Artisan offers usage-based plans priced per AI employee and lead volume. Plans scale from early-stage startups to larger mid-market teams.

## Plans
- Starter: for small teams getting started with AI outbound.
- Growth: for scaling sales teams that need higher send volume and advanced personalization.
- Enterprise: custom pricing for larger organizations, with dedicated support, security review, and onboarding.

Most customers are sales teams of 5 to 200 seats. Enterprise plans include SSO and custom data retention.
